title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: PagerDuty connectors for escalation policies and on-call schedules
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly generalises organisation-wide default access to both connectors; schedules default to people with source access. It also labels included connector grounding as a separate add-on and asserts an undocumented default for indexing team relationships. The documented deployment paths and Graph delete call otherwise check out.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans a PagerDuty connection for escalation policies and on-call schedules.
claims.quote: Customers can connect M365 Copilot with PagerDuty to access escalation policies and on-call schedules with Copilot Connector.
